About the Chef

Amit Soni

A calm, pleasant and hardworking chef with a genuine passion for great food and the craft of cooking. Amit thrives on the energy of a busy kitchen, and finds his greatest reward in the happy faces of guests enjoying a dish he has prepared. A natural leader, he is equally at home directing a team as he is working the pass himself.

“Great pleasure out of seeing happy faces enjoying a good meal.”

Chapter One

Signature Creations

01

Grilled Peach Burrata Salad

Creamy burrata crowned with oscietra caviar, heirloom cherry tomatoes, honey-glazed baby carrots, marinated cucumber ribbon and grilled peach, finished with a crisp herb tuile and basil oil.

02

Spaghetti & Beef Meatballs

Hand-rolled beef meatballs simmered in San Marzano tomato sauce over spaghetti, with shaved parmesan, blistered cherry tomatoes and micro basil.

03

Burrata, Fig & Heirloom Tomato

Silky burrata over baby greens and radicchio with fresh figs and heirloom cherry tomatoes, finished with extra virgin olive oil.

04

Crispy Pasta Fritto, Smoked Turkey

Panko-crusted brie over mixed greens, strawberries and cured meats, topped with cured ham, salmon roe and a squid-ink tuile.

05

Herb-Crusted Fish & Mussels

Herb-crumb crusted fish in a saffron-scented broth with fresh mussels and glazed baby carrots, finished with salmon roe, dill and a crisp tuile.

06

Beetroot Mousse Tartlets

Delicate pastry tartlets filled with whipped beetroot mousse, micro arugula, mango pearls and basil caviar over a beetroot reduction.

07

Italian-Style Scotch Egg

A soft-boiled egg in a sun-dried tomato and mozzarella crust, breaded and fried, with fresh mozzarella, cherry tomatoes, basil oil and balsamic reduction.

08

Watermelon Feta Salad, Balsamic Caviar

Char-grilled watermelon glazed with balsamic reduction and whipped citrus cream, topped with oscietra caviar and watermelon and mint pearls.

09

Beetroot Carpaccio & Goat Cheese

Thin-sliced roasted beetroot with whipped goat cheese, pickled shallots, micro greens and a balsamic reduction.

Chef’s Tool

Food Cost Calculator

–Cost of goods sold
–Cost %
–Gross margin
COGS = opening inventory + purchases − closing inventory. Cost % = COGS ÷ revenue. Gross margin = (revenue − COGS) ÷ revenue.
